languageModelTools.name: azure-sdk-generation-planner
languageModelTools.userDescription: Plan and execute Azure SDK generation workflows
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Plan and generate AZURE Sdk (i.e. Azure Python SDK, Azure Java SDK...) from typespec project. Always use this tool for generating AZURE Sdk including:
- Starting new generation
- Continuing existing generation that were interrupted
- Resuming after fixing compilation errors
Call this tool when the user asks to "continue" generation work or when you encounter TypeSpec compilation issues during generation.

language.description: the target language of the Azure SDK to generate

tspConfigPath.description: the path to the tspconfig.yaml file of the service to generate Azure SDK. User should at least provide the service name when prompting to generate Azure SDK for. i.e. .../azure-rest-api-specs/specification/*/*/tspconfig.yaml

pythonSdkRepoRoot.description: the local root folder of the Azure Python SDK repository

languageModelTools.displayName: Compile typespec and fix compilation errors
languageModelTools.userDescription: Compile typespec and fix compilation errors
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compile the typespec project and fix compilation errors. This tool is used to compile the typespec project and fix any compilation errors that may occur. It is useful when the user asks to "compile" the typespec project or when you encounter TypeSpec compilation issues during generation.

tspConfigPath.description: the path to the tspconfig.yaml file for the typespec project to compile and fix
